page.overview:
What is Kadabra?

Kadabra has a similar anatomy to Abra; however, there are some differences. Kadabra holds a metal spoon forged by its psychic powers. Also, Kadabra's tail is large and curly. It also has a "mustache". The mustache is larger on male Kadabra's. Kadabra's stomach has three red stripes, while its forehead has a five-pointed red star.

Kadabra remain floating while they sleep, using their flexible tails as pillows. Kadabra in danger may be able to perform more powerful attacks than usual.

Kadabra can have the ability Synchronize or the ability Inner Focus. It does not have a strong physical body but prefers to use its psychic powers. If this Pokémon is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck. It is also said that to control this Pokémon in the most beneficial way you should have psychic powers, like the trainer Sabrina. When Kadabra is around, its strong psychic powers can sometimes interfere with electronics like computer monitors or televisions.

Kadabra evolves from Abra starting at level 16 and evolves into Alakazam if traded.
